title: Atomic evaluation is polynomial-time decidable
statement: Let $C_w,c_w\in\mathbb{N}$, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $a$ be an atom over the states and work tapes of $M$. The language of finite Boolean words $z$ for which the evaluation of $a$ on $z$ is true belongs to $P$, the class of languages decidable in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$a$ is an atom over the states and work tapes of $M$
